messages:
maya: heads up, ap-south-1 apiserver 95p latency spike since ~00:05 UTC, concurrent etcd wal fsync latency up, controller-manager is flipping leaders, GPU scheduling backlog ~120 pods pending in `gpu-reserved` pool
sam: saw the alert, pulling metrics now. infra-bot showed a cluster-wide apiserver surge. can you paste the apiserver error stream?
maya: paste logs: ```W0320 00:06:12.345 apiserver.go:234] apiserver trace: Trace[123456]: ... etag wait: [etcdclient] 0.78s; total 0.79s
E0320 00:06:13.112 reflector.go:123] k8s.io/client-go/informers/factory.go: failed to watch *v1.Node: etcdserver: request timed out```
infra-bot: alert: `apiserver_latency_p95 > 400ms` (ap-south-1) at 00:06:18 UTC
eli: controller-manager logs show leader resign and immediate re-election repeatedly, leaderLease duration is default 15s. requeue spikes visible in event stream. snippet: ```I0320 00:06:14 controller_manager.go: leader election lost, trying to reacquire```
tara: gpu autoscaler reports nodes draining in preemptible pool - several preemptible GPUs evicted between 00:03-00:07 UTC, but non-preemptible pool has available quota. Could be correlated with control-plane instability.
ken: I'm seeing elevated `etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds` on etcd-2; iops for the attached volume in the cloud console shows burst exhausted and then heavy retrying. provider shows egress shaping in that region (support note: "mitigating noisy-tenant egress, throttling flows >X Mbps").
sam: interesting — etcd raft traffic is inter-node over the private network; if egress shaping is applied at hypervisor or VPC egress, that could add latency to wal replication. that would then cause apiserver timeouts and leader flips.
maya: can someone run `kubectl -n kube-system logs etcd-2 --since=10m`?
sam: pasted relevant lines: ```2026-03-20T00:05:50.123Z etcdserver: wal fsync took 1.2s (ret: 0); network: write tcp 10.2.0.5:2380: write: connection reset by peer```
eli: also found a transient route rewrite in the VPC firewall rules pushed by infra-automation at 00:04 UTC — rule id rf-778 with aggressive ephemeral-port NAT disabled.
tara: who ran that change? @ken any deploys?
ken: that was my CR to block a misconfigured peering export; I reverted at 00:10 UTC when paging started. I did not expect it to impact intra-cluster overlay traffic; looks like provider NAT was touching internal replication flows.
maya: after revert apiserver p95 dropped to ~80ms and etcd fsyncs returned to baseline around 00:12 UTC. controller-manager re-elected a stable leader at 00:14 UTC, scheduler backlog drained over next 8m.
sam: action items: 1) file a provider support ticket about region-level NAT/egress shaping affecting private overlay traffic (include packet captures), 2) add a monitoring rule for `etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds` > 0.5s and trigger paging, 3) change controller-manager leaderLease to 30s for now to reduce flip noise during transient blips.
eli: +1 on leaderLease increase while we investigate. we'll test if 30s reduces churn risk for short egress transients.
tara: also we should mark the preemptible GPU pool as lower-priority scheduling while control plane is recovering — it caused extra churn and cost as many pods got requeued and restarted. put autoscaler into pause for the next 30m.
ken: opened ticket INC-1234 with provider support, attached etcd logs and timings. also created internal follow-up GH issue infra/egress-shaping-impact with notes on automated change rollback and testing checklist.
maya: closing loop: immediate rollback + revert of rf-778 fixed the outage. no customer-facing errors were observed (all API calls eventually succeeded). cost note: the requeues triggered ~3k extra GPU-minutes across preemptible nodes — cost impact ~ $420. will include in the incident report.
sam: recommend postmortem: timeline, why ephemeral NAT/blocking rule touched overlay, a playbook entry: "if control-plane latency rises AND etcd fsyncs spike, check recent VPC rule changes and pause autoscaler for volatile pools"
eli: I'll draft the postmortem and include the suggested mitigations and lease tweak.
tara: thanks everyone. 1hr follow-up ticker at 01:15 UTC to validate no recurrence. :thumbsup:
